# Stories plan

One Story sequence per feed post, same day, 3 frames: (1) the post teaser or a sticker, (2) the interactive sticker, (3) link sticker with today's tracked link. Stories hold the warm audience and lift early signals on the next feed post. Reply to every sticker response within 24 hours.
